name: what-if-tony-stark-built-this
description: Invent and prove better engineering mechanisms when the existing approach hits a consequential constraint. By Lex from SigmaStudioz.

interface.displayName: What If Tony Stark Built This
interface.longDescription: For developers and technical teams comparing ways to solve an engineering constraint. Describe the goal and available evidence, then use the skill to identify assumptions, compare alternative designs and plan a small experiment. It helps produce a design comparison, test plan and findings with explicit limitations. An optional local Python runner compares user-selected implementations against supplied cases and records timing and memory measurements. Review those implementations before running them: the runner executes local code and is not a sandbox. No external service is required. Measurements apply to the supplied cases and environment; the skill does not promise a breakthrough or a faster design.
